_comment: A hard stun on the nearest enemy: movement stops and its cast path is suppressed too, unlike a slow which only affects movement. Damage does not break it. It authors no targetFactions list because mob-side cc-immunity already decides which mobs can be stunned; elites and bosses are immune there. The target keeps its threat table. All values placeholder.
name: Paralyze
description: Damage does not break it, your own aura included.
